mapper.sql: punch_correction_request_id AS request_id, employee_id, request_month, business_date, punch_side, correction_reason, status, requested_at, requested_by, reviewed_at, reviewed_by, review_notes
mapper.select: SELECT employee_id FROM employee WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM auth_principal principal JOIN auth_principal_role_assignment assignment ON assignment.principal_id = principal.principal_id JOIN auth_role role ON role.role_id = assignment.role_id WHERE principal.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND principal.status = 'ACTIVE' AND role.role_code = 'EXECUTIVE' AND assignment.valid_from <= #{knowledgeAsOf} AND (assignment.valid_to IS NULL OR assignment.valid_to > #{knowledgeAsOf}) ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO punch_correction_request ( punch_correction_request_id, employee_id, request_month, business_date, punch_side, correction_reason, status, requested_at, requested_by, reviewed_at, reviewed_by, review_notes, created_at ) VALUES ( #{row.requestId}, #{row.employeeId}, #{row.requestMonth}, #{row.businessDate}, #{row.punchSide}, #{row.correctionReason}, #{row.status}, #{row.requestedAt}, #{row.requestedBy}, #{row.reviewedAt}, #{row.reviewedBy}, #{row.reviewNotes}, #{row.requestedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE punch_correction_request SET status = 'APPROVED', reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt}, reviewed_by = #{reviewerId}, review_notes = #{reviewNotes} WHERE punch_correction_request_id = #{requestId} AND status = 'PENDING'
